Senior PowerBuilder Developer

Technical leadership and application modernisation

Brussels * Hybrid * 3 days on site per week

Contract options: permanent, fixed-term or freelance | Start: as soon as possible

About the role

Help shape the next chapter of a business-critical application. You will combine hands-on PowerBuilder development and production support with technical leadership, preparing an established client/server platform for a progressive transition to Java and Angular.

The role connects existing application knowledge with future development: understanding how the system works, making its business rules explicit and helping developers carry them into the new platform.

Your responsibilities

• Resolve complex PowerBuilder issues and share production maintenance duties, following agreed support and documentation practices.
• Analyse application components and dependencies, including PBLs, PowerScript, PFC, DataWindows and DataStores.
• Identify business rules, edge cases and redundant behaviour; separate functional requirements from interface logic and historical workarounds.
• Decouple business logic from GUI controls and database access, including embedded SQL, dynamic SQL and stored procedures.
• Work with analysts and business specialists to translate existing behaviour into clear functional and technical specifications.
• Collaborate with Java/Angular developers on REST API contracts and validate regression coverage through characterisation and Golden Master tests.
• Build shared technical documentation, mentor colleagues and use static analysis and AI-assisted tools to maintain traceability between code and specifications.

What you bring

• At least 5 years of hands-on PowerBuilder development, with strong expertise in the PowerBuilder 8-2022 / Appeon environment.
• Advanced PowerScript and PFC knowledge: events, functions, structures, transaction handling (SQLCA, COMMIT, ROLLBACK), complex DataWindows (Composite, Group, Nested), expressions (Describe, Modify, Evaluate) and DataStores.
• Strong relational database and SQL skills, including transactional SQL, PL/SQL stored procedures and query optimisation.
• Understanding of stateless REST APIs, microservices, Spring Boot, Angular and JSON DTOs. Practical Java/Spring Boot and/or Angular experience, or a strong aptitude and willingness to develop these skills.
• An analytical approach, clear documentation for non-PowerBuilder developers and confident communication with business stakeholders, management and technical teams.
• French or Dutch, together with professional fluency in English.
Why consider this role

A hands-on technical lead opportunity combining production continuity, knowledge sharing and modernisation. Contribute to team development while building on your PowerBuilder expertise and expanding your involvement in Java and Angular.

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Junior IT Recruiter
jobs.description:
Looking to start your career in recruitment? Enjoy talking to people, asking questions and finding out what makes them tick?

I'm looking for a Junior IT Recruiter to work alongside me at Oliver James in Brussels. You'll learn how to find, qualify and build relationships with IT professionals, helping us fill roles with the right people.

This role is 100% focused on candidates. There is no business development, client prospecting or responsibility for winning new clients. Your focus will be on building a strong candidate network within your IT specialisation and matching those people with opportunities we're already working on.
What you'll do

• Find the right people. Use LinkedIn Recruiter, our database and referrals to identify IT professionals who match our recruitment needs.

• Start conversations. Reach out to candidates, introduce relevant opportunities and get them interested in speaking with you.

• Get to know your candidates. Run qualification calls to understand their experience, technical skills, career goals, availability and salary or rate expectations.

• Build lasting relationships. Stay in regular contact with promising candidates, including those who aren't ready to move yet.

• Know who's ready for their next move. Maintain an up-to-date shortlist of qualified, engaged candidates so we can respond quickly when a suitable role comes in.

• Keep things organised. Record useful notes and next steps in our recruitment system, making sure conversations lead to proper follow-up.

• Work closely with me. Understand the requirements of each role, share what you're hearing from candidates and help identify the strongest matches

Who we're looking for

You don't need recruitment experience or a technical background. We're looking for someone who wants to learn and is willing to put in the work.

You'll be a good fit if you:

• Speak fluent French and English. Dutch is a plus.

• Enjoy speaking with people and feel comfortable picking up the phone.

• Are curious enough to go beyond a CV and understand what someone actually does and wants.

• Can stay organised while following up with several candidates at different stages.

• Keep going when someone doesn't reply or an initial approach doesn't work.

• Welcome feedback and want to improve.

• Have an interest in technology and are willing to learn the differences between IT roles.

What you'll learn:

• You'll receive hands-on training and work closely with an experienced headhunter specialising in the Belgian software engineering market.

• We'll cover how to search effectively, approach candidates, run useful qualification calls and build a network that you know well.

• You'll also develop your understanding of IT specialisations so you can have increasingly confident and relevant conversations.

• As you progress, you'll take more ownership of your candidate network and become someone people turn to when they're considering their next career move.

Interested?

Send me your CV or a short message explaining why this role interests you.

Previous recruitment experience isn't required.

I'd like to hear what makes you want to give it a go.
-
